properties.title: LP NS Epithermal Neutron – Pixon Reconstruction (Wilson et al., 2018)
properties.lri:data_use_note: Spatial targeting, not quantitative estimate. Values are neutron count rates — use this map to identify WHERE hydrogen enrichment is highest. Low count rate = more hydrogen. For quantitative hydrogen abundance, cross-reference with grs/0.5deg/hydrogen/.
properties.psf_function: kappa function (Lawrence et al., 2003; Maurice et al., 2004)
properties.measurement_depth: few tens of centimeters (bulk subsurface, not surface)
properties.authors: J. T. Wilson, D. J. Lawrence, P. N. Peplowski, J. T. S. Cahill, V. R. Eke, R. J. Massey, L. F. A. Teodoro
properties.lri:quality_note: MEP reconstruction of the LP-NS epithermal neutron map (Wilson et al., 2018). Effective resolution 61 km vs. ~45 km FWHM original PSF; improvement is primarily noise suppression given the low SNR of this channel. Cd-coated ³He detector screens thermal neutrons, making this channel nearly exclusively sensitive to hydrogen. Prefer over the original PDS epithermal map (ns/epithermal/) for feature identification and ISRU prospecting.
properties.processing:lineage: Upstream NS data reduction: Maurice et al. (2004). PSF determined from kappa function (Lawrence et al., 2003; Maurice et al., 2004) accounting for spacecraft motion (Wilson et al., 2015). Pixon reconstruction applied by Wilson et al. (2018). COG production: source jgre20969-sup-0002-supplementary.txt (Dataset S1); comment lines stripped; 524288 space-delimited float64 values parsed and reshaped to 512×1024 (row-major, north→south); written as raw Float32 LSB binary via Python struct; GDAL VRT (epithermal_wilson.vrt) used to assign CRS (IAU:30100) and geotransform; gdal_translate to COG with DEFLATE/PREDICTOR=3 compression.
